name: Canon FT QL
note: FL and FD are different mounts and this body predates FD by five years: the FT QL is 1966, FD arrived 1971 on the F-1/FTb. Every source agreed (camera-wiki 'FL', Wikipedia 'Canon FL'), but the bare 'FL' token was unresolvable, so merge backfilled from the deterministic name inference, whose \bftb?\b regex swept the plain FT into the FD rule. The regex is fixed in the forge (FT→FL, FTb/FTb-N→FD); this row pins the record so no future source regression can flip it back. Surfaced by the inventory conflict band: 'yours Canon FL · gearbook Canon FD'.

name: Canon FL 55 mm f/ 1.2
note: allphotolenses carries two rows under this name — c_2286 (the real FL 55/1.2, 1968, mount 'Canon FL') and c_2486 (mount 'Canon FD, FDn', evidently the FD 55mm f/1.2 filed under the FL name; that lens has its own record here). The name-merge let the mislabeled row's mount win. A lens named FL is the FL breech-lock by definition — stop-down metering, no full-aperture signal pin — and does not mount-couple as an FD.
